text:
The forest‑seeded palms, the offering of fragrant flowers, and also the deer that roams there, the universal (all‑pervading) one.  
Just as, by the curious eyes of those companions, the gaze is drawn forward.  

Having performed the proper consecration, the sacrificial offspring, the Veda‑knower, you, the one who is accompanied by the answer‑giver, the learned woman who has been instructed, the one whose direction is fixed by the trees, the sages approach her; in the elders who increase in righteousness, the age is examined.
